lesson.title: Doing Things Together
lesson.subtitle: Topic-based beginner conversation lesson
lesson.description: Practice invite another person to eat or drink with you. Transcript-referenced conversational Mandarin study organized by communicative goal rather than audio track.

learning_objectives: Invite another person to eat or drink with you.
Ask who someone is going with.

blocks.text: Learn to invite another person to eat or drink with you. Use the model conversation to notice the expressions, then practise the patterns and speak aloud.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 你想跟我一起吃午饭吗？
turns.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng gēn wǒ yìqǐ chī wǔfàn ma?
turns.english: Would you like to have lunch with me?

turns.speaker: B
turns.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ yě xiǎng gēn nǐ yìqǐ chī.
turns.english: Yes, I would like to eat with you too.

turns.speaker: B
turns.english: Let us go to a restaurant.

blocks.pattern_hanzi: 跟 + 人 + 一起 + 动词
blocks.function_en: 跟 (gēn) introduces the person accompanying you; 一起 (yìqǐ) means together.

example.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ yìqǐ chīfàn.
example.english: I would like to eat with you.
example.teaching_note: Use this construction in your own dialogue.

blocks.function_en: 也 (yě) adds agreement or another participant doing the same thing.

example.teaching_note: Use this construction in your own dialogue.

blocks.text: Speaking task: Invite someone to lunch, accept or decline, and decide where to go together.

questions.prompt: In the model conversation, what does speaker B say in the first reply?
questions.answer: 好，我也想跟你一起吃。 (Hǎo, wǒ yě xiǎng gēn nǐ yìqǐ chī.) — Yes, I would like to eat with you too.
questions.explanation: Read the first two turns again, then answer without looking.

questions.prompt: Translate into Mandarin: Would you like to have lunch with me?
questions.answer: 你想跟我一起吃午饭吗 (nǐ xiǎng gēn wǒ yìqǐ chī wǔfàn ma)
questions.explanation: One model answer; another natural equivalent may be acceptable.

questions.prompt: Make a sentence using the pattern 也 + 动词短语 (yě dòngcí duǎnyǔ).
questions.answer: 我也想去。 (wǒ yě xiǎng qù.) — I want to go too.
questions.explanation: Use the word order shown in the second grammar explanation.

questions.prompt: Invite someone to lunch, accept or decline, and decide where to go together.
questions.answer: 你想跟我一起吃午饭吗？ (Nǐ xiǎng gēn wǒ yìqǐ chī wǔfàn ma?) — 好，我也想跟你一起吃。 (Hǎo, wǒ yě xiǎng gēn nǐ yìqǐ chī.)
questions.explanation: Sample opening exchange. Continue the role-play in your own words.
